caption: The drawing depicts a geometric quilt pattern composed of repeating curved and diamond shapes arranged in a grid. The pattern consists of two main colors: red and white. The red sections are decorated with small white floral motifs, while the white sections are filled with evenly spaced blue dots. The curved red shapes form interlocking arcs and segments that create a sense of circular motion throughout the composition. Diamond-shaped white areas, intersected by curved lines, are positioned at the intersections of the arcs, with red diamond-shaped details set inside each. The overall layout forms a symmetrical and balanced design. The entire patterned design is set within a rectangular frame with a plain off-white border.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
